title: Corrections module: Clone, Heal and AI Remove
objective: Deliver an offline, non-destructive Clone/Heal baseline and an optional provider-agnostic AI Remove workflow with durable frozen results, user-controlled models and exact UI/API parity.
context_summary: Planning proposal, not implementation authorization. The earlier roadmap excludes generative editing until the owner accepts the new scope. Clone/Heal can proceed independently. AI implementation requires the shared settings, permissions, resource and derived-artifact capabilities in docs/design/module-capabilities.md; no cross-file task IDs are used.

tasks.description: Resolve corrections behavior, repair-stage ordering and the owner decision gates.
extra_context: The roadmap currently excludes generative editing; this is a proposal until the owner explicitly accepts the new scope.
Decide how RAW source-development changes invalidate a frozen AI result. The proposed policy fails render/sample/export explicitly until regeneration or removal.

context_links.label: Corrections proposal
context_links.relevance: Full behavior, proposed stage and acceptance.

context_links.label: Roadmap
context_links.relevance: Prior scope and placement of clone/heal.

acceptance_criteria: Record owner acceptance or rejection of AI scope, repair stage, stale-prefix policy, remote consent scope and first-provider qualification threshold.
Freeze operation ordering, content coordinates, mask blending, artifact dependency hash and history labels before implementation.
Keep any unanswered consequential question explicitly open and prevent dependent AI implementation from being reported as accepted.

steps: Review the proposed contract against current stage/recipe constraints and owner workflow.
Inspect a written decision record and update the design only for settled choices.
expected_results: One current design with explicit accepted decisions and remaining gates.

tasks.description: Select and freeze the Clone and Heal numerical contract against independent references.
extra_context: Clone and Heal should remain a useful offline baseline even if AI qualification fails.
acceptance_criteria: Specify brush rasterization, subpixel path interpolation, feather/opacity, source offset, edge handling, overlap order and heal solver with bounded convergence.
Independent reference fixtures cover flat, gradient, texture, high-contrast boundary, tiny/large strokes, image edge and RAW float values.
Publish visual failure cases and performance bounds without claiming Lightroom pixel equivalence.

steps: Run a standalone numerical study using synthetic fixtures and compare candidate heal methods.
Inspect rendered photo-sized cases with recorded parameters.
expected_results: Frozen, independently checkable Clone/Heal equations and test fixtures.

tasks.description: Add the narrow repair stage and bounded regional processing primitive.
extra_context: Preserve stored layer order; no catalog migration or generalized graph. The owner thread plans but never rasterizes.
Answer every performance-rules checklist item for changes under crates.

context_links.label: Module stage contract
context_links.relevance: Current stage insertion and processing primitives.

acceptance_criteria: New repair effects insert after source development and before colour/spatial/geometry without moving older layers; unsupported stacks fail with named errors.
Regional clone/heal reads the exact prefix with bounded tiles/scratch and cancellation; JPEG and RAW paths preserve declared precision and sample/render agreement.
Exact-buffer fixtures cover overlapping operations, edges, orientation/crop, undo/redo/reopen, source preservation and frame-limit failure.

steps: Compare compiled output with independent stepwise reference on synthetic JPEG and float RAW inputs.
Measure photo-sized 24/60 MP output and point-query cost before integration.
expected_results: The host primitive is exact, bounded and stage-correct.

tasks.description: Add a semantic brush-mask descriptor, desktop canvas overlay and API path schema.
extra_context: Pointer events remain desktop-only; API clients submit bounded stroke geometry, source coordinates and add/subtract operations directly.
acceptance_criteria: Descriptor registration validates brush binding, size, feather, opacity, path/mask limits and selection actions; schema.list and module.list expose them.
Desktop brush capture renders an immediate overlay, one commit on release/Apply and none on Cancel; stale revisions retain a recoverable draft.
The same stroke path, source handle and mask edits can be submitted as semantic JSON calls without pointer simulation.

steps: Test descriptor rejection and JSON shape, then exercise drawing, cancellation and conflict in a hidden-window native scenario.
Compare desktop-generated request with direct API request.
expected_results: Brush mode is discoverable and UI/API paths describe the same edit.

tasks.description: Implement the corrections module's ordered Clone/Heal operations and edit actions.
extra_context: One layer holds stable operation IDs; actions add, update, remove and reorder operations without module-owned catalog writes.
acceptance_criteria: The module owns validated stroke/source payloads and compiles ordered Clone/Heal operations through the host primitive; all actions appear in schema.list.
Each successful operation changes one ordinary history entry; no-op, wrong operation ID, bad source and stale mutation have explicit outcomes.
Changing a crop or orientation carries corrections in content space; source development recomputes Clone/Heal rather than silently freezing pixels.

steps: Drive add/update/delete/reorder through the shared service and inspect recipe/history.
Compare exact output and source hashes after reopen and restore.
expected_results: Clone and Heal have reproducible durable results and complete API coverage.

tasks.description: Deliver and verify the offline Clone/Heal desktop workflow.
extra_context: This is the first usable handoff and does not require settings, credentials or AI resources.
acceptance_criteria: The generated Corrections section selects Clone or Heal, paints/edit/selects operations, moves source handles and shows immediate overlay/preview without freezing the UI.
Native M4 captures correlate selected mode, operation IDs, exact pixels, history and logs; API performs the same journey and undo/redo/restore/reopen.
Document Clone/Heal quality limits and run quick, rendered and timing tiers at this integration point.

steps: Use a background-only editor launch with an isolated catalog and fixture; review captures as images.
Check API parity, source hashes and 24/60 MP timing.
commands: cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- verify --tier rendered --output NEW_DIR
cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- verify --tier timing --output NEW_DIR
expected_results: A free offline correction workflow is usable and proven on the M4.

tasks.description: Qualify local and remote AI Remove candidates and select a provider set.
extra_context: LaMa is a non-generative inpainting baseline; PowerPaint and other candidates need independent weight/runtime terms. Do not claim Adobe quality from an architecture label.
Evaluate at equivalent mask/context sizes, including model-specific resizing and colour conversion.
acceptance_criteria: Compare at least one local inpainting baseline, one local generative object-removal candidate and one hosted provider on a rights-cleared fixed image/mask corpus.
Record blind visual scores and failures, changed pixels outside mask, M4 cold/warm time, peak RSS/GPU memory, disk, backend portability, model/runtime/weight terms and provenance.
Select exact model versions and at least two distinct provider paths for implementation; if no local model clears explicit thresholds, record the reason and leave local delivery conditional.

steps: Run candidate adapters outside the app with pinned artifacts and repeatable inputs.
Inspect side-by-side outputs and measurements; record license sources separately from unverified conclusions.
expected_results: A reproducible selection report with a justified local yes/no decision and provider set.

tasks.description: Integrate immutable AI repair patches, mask composition and prefix invalidation.
extra_context: Requires the generic host artifact storage from the module-capabilities design before implementation; no cross-plan task IDs are encoded here.
Rendering uses a frozen host-owned patch and never invokes its generation provider.

context_links.label: Corrections proposal
context_links.relevance: Frozen patch, mask and stale-prefix contract.

acceptance_criteria: Accepted patch bytes, mask, transform, provider/model provenance and input-prefix hash persist atomically with the recipe reference.
Pixels outside the committed mask are exact-prefix pixels; output within it is validated/linearized, and saved RAW source data remain unchanged.
Model removal/offline reopen still renders and exports accepted corrections; missing/corrupt patch and stale prefix fail explicitly, with history intact.
Artifact reachability covers every retained branch/version, restore and catalog restart.

steps: Inject crash, corrupt/missing artifact and source-development change; compare exact prefix/outside-mask buffers.
Remove model and credentials and verify offline render, sample, export and history.
expected_results: Frozen AI edits remain non-destructive, durable and honest about missing or stale data.

tasks.description: Implement a qualified downloadable local inference adapter when its candidate passes.
extra_context: If qualification rejects all local models, complete this task only by recording a no-go with evidence and keep local AI unavailable; do not substitute an unreviewed model.
Generic download, settings, permissions, activation and bounded workers from module-capabilities are prerequisites.

context_links.label: Generic resources
context_links.relevance: Verified download, runtime trust and activation.

context_links.label: Performance rules
context_links.relevance: Bounded model work and honest measurements.

acceptance_criteria: When selected, exact model/runtime versions and hashes are downloadable on user request to app-managed storage, never bundled or silently fetched.
An installed model loads through a reviewed, bounded, cancellable worker and accepts the common image/mask job; removing it preserves accepted patches.
If no candidate passes the written license/quality/resource gate, document the rejection and expose a clear unavailable-local status without claiming implementation.

steps: Exercise install/load/generate/cancel/uninstall on M4 with hashes and an offline fixture.
Measure cold/warm latency, memory, disk and unchanged idle state.
expected_results: One qualified local adapter or an explicit evidence-backed no-go, with no silent fallback.

tasks.description: Implement typed remote AI adapters and provider selection.
extra_context: Requires generic settings, secret storage, network permission and jobs; first live providers are chosen in the qualification task.
Do not pass original paths, EXIF or extra image bytes by default.

context_links.label: Corrections proposal
context_links.relevance: Remote provider contract and multiple paths.

context_links.label: Generic consent
context_links.relevance: Scoped photo transfer, credentials and endpoint validation.

acceptance_criteria: At least two distinct real provider paths are available across local/remote options; if local is not qualified, use two remote adapters, with separately configurable model IDs.
Adapters declare request masks, dimensions, authentication, timeouts, cancellation, variations, cost/data disclosure and response validation.
No photograph leaves without the recorded scoped grant; denial, secret missing, endpoint edit, provider refusal, malformed output and disconnect leave the recipe unchanged.
Mock protocol tests and live small-case tests are labelled separately.

steps: Run fake servers for every malformed/error/cancel case and exact sent-byte inspection.
Exercise selected live providers on rights-cleared images with explicit consent and cost bounds.
expected_results: Provider choice works through one user-facing job/result contract with truthful privacy and failure behavior.

tasks.description: Add AI Remove mask refinement, candidate review and atomic acceptance to the Corrections UI/API.
extra_context: A local no-go in TASK-009 does not block an accepted remote AI delivery; candidate acceptance rechecks revision and prefix before commit.

context_links.label: Corrections proposal
context_links.relevance: AI interaction and acceptance race rules.

acceptance_criteria: Paint/add/subtract mask, choose provider/model, Generate, inspect variations, Regenerate, Accept and Cancel are available via the same service used by the desktop.
Generation holds a frozen revision/prefix; stale, cancelled, late and failed results cannot alter the current recipe; Accept creates one history entry and durable patch.
Installed local model may pre-load on activation without blocking Clone/Heal; remote upload starts only after explicit Generate/consent.
UI shows model readiness, transfer scope, cost if known, job progress and actionable errors without leaking secrets.

steps: Drive full UI and JSON journeys against a deterministic fake model and an approved real adapter.
Race external edits, cancellation, model removal and late responses; inspect captures, state and logs.
commands: cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- verify --tier rendered --output NEW_DIR
expected_results: AI Remove commits only an explicitly chosen, revision-correct result and stays responsive.

tasks.description: Run correction quality, source-preservation, security and performance acceptance.
extra_context: Exactness and naturalness are separate evidence. A skipped native or unavailable provider test is not a pass.
JPEG export verification depends on the separately planned shared exporter. If it has not shipped, this milestone cannot be marked complete.
acceptance_criteria: Independent pixel tests cover Clone/Heal, AI outside-mask identity, linear/SDR conversion, geometry, overlap and sample/exact-export consistency.
History/reopen/undo/restore, source hash, offline accepted AI, corrupt artifact, stale prefix, permission revocation, malformed response and cancellation/races pass.
Record blinded visual outcomes and failures plus M4 24/60 MP JPEG and qualified RAW timings, peak CPU/GPU memory, first/warm load and disk with setup and sample counts.
Run full verification before a milestone claim and state every skipped/unsupported case.

steps: Execute exact fixtures, API/desktop acceptance, background rendered smoke and photo-sized timing.
Review image captures and blind quality scores independently of automated success.
commands: cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- verify --tier full --output NEW_DIR
expected_results: A bounded, reproducible M4 evidence package supports only the claims actually tested.

tasks.description: Update shipped contracts and user documentation after qualification.
extra_context: Only accepted and implemented behavior enters feature status; keep remaining local/provider/platform work explicit.

context_links.label: Roadmap
context_links.relevance: Earlier exclusion that owner decision may revise.

acceptance_criteria: Module/API design, roadmap, feature status and user guide describe the actual Clone/Heal and AI paths, their precision and persistence limits, privacy/consent, model download and recovery.
Unqualified local models, untested platforms, deferred license review and any measured target misses remain labelled as such.
Task statuses change only when their acceptance evidence exists; no proposed command or provider is documented as shipped.

steps: Compare documentation with schema.list, module.list, evidence summaries and packaged UI.
Run repository/plan validation and quick verification for the documentation change.

expected_results: Current documentation matches shipped behavior and open limitations.
